c00f7658579a4965790f9b351b8ee8552806e1cf.english: Yes, adapting to life abroad can be difficult, especially at first. Living abroad is not just about residing there: you have to communicate in a new environment, re-establish emotional connections and rebuild your daily routines, sometimes all at the same time.
c00f7658579a4965790f9b351b8ee8552806e1cf.french: Oui, s'adapter à l'étranger peut être difficile, surtout au début. Vivre à l'étranger ne consiste pas seulement à y habiter : il faut communiquer dans un nouvel environnement, retrouver des repères affectifs et reconstruire ses habitudes quotidiennes, parfois en même temps.

cbc363e28d2e03c0f323da210bc2bd3ad915941d.english: He therefore knows where to ask for information, but you do not find all those contacts again in the first few days.
cbc363e28d2e03c0f323da210bc2bd3ad915941d.french: Il sait ainsi où se renseigner, mais ces contacts ne se retrouvent pas tous dès les premiers jours.
cbc363e28d2e03c0f323da210bc2bd3ad915941d.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the conversational Immigration revision; no translation-provider call.

d8053abe5834b179d98aff427a9d723dc05b7f2d.english: Adapting therefore also involves making very practical adjustments.
d8053abe5834b179d98aff427a9d723dc05b7f2d.french: L'adaptation passe donc aussi par des ajustements très pratiques.

e60cbc91b03cc3a1b5b5a279ef2d3355f2fe4cc6.english: Calls maintain the connection, but do not always replace being there in person. We can get news and still miss the moments we used to share without planning them. It takes time to meet people we feel comfortable enough with.
e60cbc91b03cc3a1b5b5a279ef2d3355f2fe4cc6.french: Les appels entretiennent le lien, mais ne remplacent pas toujours une présence physique. On peut recevoir des nouvelles et manquer malgré tout les moments qu'on partageait sans les prévoir. Il faut du temps pour rencontrer des personnes avec lesquelles on se sent suffisamment à l'aise.
e60cbc91b03cc3a1b5b5a279ef2d3355f2fe4cc6.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the conversational Immigration revision; no translation-provider call.

ee0fd5cc33a40cd5c87bea67ef1126de5c8fc0bd.english: In our own country, we often know which doctor to consult or whom to ask a question. We rely on these contacts without thinking about it. Abroad, sometimes we do not even know whom to ask for help.
ee0fd5cc33a40cd5c87bea67ef1126de5c8fc0bd.french: Dans son pays, on sait souvent quel médecin consulter ou à qui poser une question. On s'appuie sur ces contacts sans y penser. À l'étranger, il arrive qu'on ne sache même pas à qui demander de l'aide.
ee0fd5cc33a40cd5c87bea67ef1126de5c8fc0bd.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

f23b9a624924478855ff2a3f34a9d0c8935edf7a.english: Furthermore, being far away from loved ones can make the early days difficult.
f23b9a624924478855ff2a3f34a9d0c8935edf7a.french: Ensuite, l'éloignement des proches peut rendre les débuts difficiles.

f47dd049a44cdd3d94eaf1e5f09f17e96f2513ab.deepl_english: The sense of loss does not disappear immediately, even when the plan to settle there remains a priority.
f47dd049a44cdd3d94eaf1e5f09f17e96f2513ab.english: The sense of loss does not disappear immediately, even when the person still wants to settle there.
f47dd049a44cdd3d94eaf1e5f09f17e96f2513ab.french: Le manque ne disparaît pas immédiatement, même lorsque le projet d'installation reste souhaité.
f47dd049a44cdd3d94eaf1e5f09f17e96f2513ab.review_note: Reste souhaité means still wanted; remains a priority introduces an unstated ranking of priorities.

fc8b82b84b61b6741c66356c7a32766b840a42f6.english: These reference points are rebuilt through information and encounters, but not all in the first few days.
fc8b82b84b61b6741c66356c7a32766b840a42f6.french: Ces repères se reconstruisent grâce aux informations et aux rencontres, mais pas tous dès les premiers jours.
fc8b82b84b61b6741c66356c7a32766b840a42f6.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

fdd3244ddaabfe2ec25e221443210b790e7a9546.english: Phone calls help maintain the connection, but they do not always replace being there in person. It takes time to meet people with whom you feel comfortable enough.
fdd3244ddaabfe2ec25e221443210b790e7a9546.french: Les appels entretiennent le lien, mais ne remplacent pas toujours une présence physique. Il faut du temps pour rencontrer des personnes avec lesquelles on se sent suffisamment à l'aise.

017b41b533ff7ba6f4171a5bdd150f8db5595b35.english: Firstly, a threat may make leaving necessary in order to protect oneself.
017b41b533ff7ba6f4171a5bdd150f8db5595b35.french: Tout d'abord, une menace peut rendre le départ nécessaire pour se protéger.

0bc2a10f58d05ee02249d53cfdfb37694ee5c386.english: Finally, a decision to leave may involve a combination of constraints and personal desires.
0bc2a10f58d05ee02249d53cfdfb37694ee5c386.french: Enfin, un départ peut mêler des contraintes et des envies personnelles.

15c285b4a88b63a211c3222f0a69f9c00c22ae4e.english: When you cannot find a job and your savings are running out, you risk no longer being able to pay for housing or food. Accepting a job abroad may then seem like the only way to cover these expenses.
15c285b4a88b63a211c3222f0a69f9c00c22ae4e.french: Quand on ne trouve pas d'emploi et que ses économies diminuent, on risque de ne plus pouvoir payer le logement ou la nourriture. Accepter un poste à l'étranger peut alors sembler la seule solution pour couvrir ces dépenses.
15c285b4a88b63a211c3222f0a69f9c00c22ae4e.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

206c0e72531098bfde0db19627193c6115801de2.english: A family may decide to leave because violence repeatedly forces their children's school to close. Moving to a safer country could give the children a chance to attend classes regularly again.
206c0e72531098bfde0db19627193c6115801de2.french: Une famille peut décider de partir parce que l'école des enfants doit souvent fermer à cause de la violence. S'installer dans un pays plus sûr pourrait permettre aux enfants de suivre à nouveau les cours régulièrement.
206c0e72531098bfde0db19627193c6115801de2.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

21a770aa7b58a9d3b1f6b0095d052cd73212a4cc.english: On the other hand, some people leave even though they could stay.
21a770aa7b58a9d3b1f6b0095d052cd73212a4cc.french: En revanche, certaines personnes partent alors qu'elles pourraient rester.
21a770aa7b58a9d3b1f6b0095d052cd73212a4cc.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

23112342979ac39378f030631d2f52b161f28356.deepl_english: When a person can no longer remain in safety, the decision is not the same as the calm choice of a new place to live. A distinction must be made between the desired destination and the immediate need to seek a safe place.
23112342979ac39378f030631d2f52b161f28356.english: When staying puts someone in danger, leaving isn't simply a matter of choosing where they'd like to live. They may have a destination in mind, but getting somewhere safe comes first.
23112342979ac39378f030631d2f52b161f28356.french: Lorsqu'une personne ne peut plus rester en sécurité, la décision ne ressemble pas au choix tranquille d'un nouveau cadre de vie. Il faut distinguer la destination souhaitée de la nécessité immédiate de chercher un lieu sûr.
23112342979ac39378f030631d2f52b161f28356.review_note: Conversational English distinguishes the preferred destination from the immediate need for safety; the French meaning and original provider translation are retained.

2e16f6cd44772ea7efb72046f4c4037982e283e4.english: A family under threat that cannot find a safe place within its own country may seek refuge abroad without having planned this departure. They are then leaving behind their familiar surroundings to protect themselves, rather than leaving simply because they prefer another country.
2e16f6cd44772ea7efb72046f4c4037982e283e4.french: Une famille menacée qui ne trouve pas de lieu sûr dans son pays peut chercher refuge à l'étranger sans avoir préparé ce départ. Elle abandonne alors ses repères pour se protéger, plutôt que partir simplement parce qu'un autre pays lui plaît davantage.

313ca0cf13f05abfabd53cca33e623a23f2a7948.english: He is choosing that job, but staying without an income is not a realistic alternative.
313ca0cf13f05abfabd53cca33e623a23f2a7948.french: Il choisit cet emploi, mais rester sans revenu n'est pas une véritable solution.
313ca0cf13f05abfabd53cca33e623a23f2a7948.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

557e4199896e57e1cb446f78d409fa42fd60448d.english: An employee can keep her job or accept a two-year assignment abroad. She chooses the assignment to discover a different way of working.
557e4199896e57e1cb446f78d409fa42fd60448d.french: Une salariée peut garder son poste ou accepter une mission de deux ans à l'étranger. Elle choisit la mission pour découvrir une autre façon de travailler.
557e4199896e57e1cb446f78d409fa42fd60448d.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

6762f0e42d7a4223f9ba67418de94b4962562427.english: In conclusion, financial difficulties and insecurity often push people to leave. But some really do have the option to stay, and someone leaving out of necessity may also want a change of life.
6762f0e42d7a4223f9ba67418de94b4962562427.french: En conclusion, les difficultés économiques et l'insécurité poussent souvent à partir. Mais certains peuvent vraiment choisir de rester, et on peut aussi avoir envie de changer de vie tout en partant par nécessité.
6762f0e42d7a4223f9ba67418de94b4962562427.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

72e77c86641c560d7dbf8a2988b029861aad1722.deepl_english: Having a plan therefore does not mean that one leaves without financial pressure.
72e77c86641c560d7dbf8a2988b029861aad1722.english: So even a planned move can be driven by financial pressure.
72e77c86641c560d7dbf8a2988b029861aad1722.french: Avoir un projet ne veut donc pas dire qu'on part sans pression financière.
72e77c86641c560d7dbf8a2988b029861aad1722.review_note: Conversational English preserves the contrast between a planned move and financial pressure; the original provider translation is retained.

76be8a76115a6e75a1972cf8d19e9d178c40fa9f.english: You have to listen to the person to understand why they are leaving.
76be8a76115a6e75a1972cf8d19e9d178c40fa9f.french: Il faut écouter la personne pour comprendre pourquoi elle part.

796411136b8bff4248f92e5d614eb1a39729f7ce.english: Her move is therefore driven by a wish, not by a lack of options at home.
796411136b8bff4248f92e5d614eb1a39729f7ce.french: Son départ répond donc à une envie, pas à l'absence de solution chez elle.
796411136b8bff4248f92e5d614eb1a39729f7ce.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

870365848f56c6a6016ed2fae9c9b1077edf8db6.english: First, a lack of work can push people to leave in order to support their family.
870365848f56c6a6016ed2fae9c9b1077edf8db6.french: Tout d'abord, le manque de travail peut pousser à partir pour faire vivre sa famille.
870365848f56c6a6016ed2fae9c9b1077edf8db6.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

8d0e007817a6244089de6c46fc7bca2360589551.english: Of course, reasons can overlap: you may be trying to get away from difficulties and also want a new life. We therefore need to look at each person's real options.
8d0e007817a6244089de6c46fc7bca2360589551.french: Bien sûr, les raisons peuvent se mélanger : on peut fuir des difficultés tout en ayant envie d'une nouvelle vie. Il faut donc qu'on regarde les possibilités réelles de chaque personne.
8d0e007817a6244089de6c46fc7bca2360589551.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

90730a0b2a7c067f72c976395f1ae340125e0392.english: One might wish to explore a country, join a loved one or set up a business, whilst still having the option to stay. Having better opportunities elsewhere does not necessarily mean one is obliged to leave.
90730a0b2a7c067f72c976395f1ae340125e0392.french: On peut vouloir découvrir un pays, rejoindre un proche ou développer une activité, tout en ayant une possibilité de rester. Avoir de meilleures possibilités ailleurs ne signifie pas forcément qu'on est obligé de partir.

9e27f8b25cf4cfbf60a63c5a099814e30465b39e.english: In conclusion, constraints can be decisive. However, I would distinguish between protection, economic necessity and a chosen course of action, without making the lack of choice a general explanation for departures.
9e27f8b25cf4cfbf60a63c5a099814e30465b39e.french: En conclusion, les contraintes peuvent être décisives. Mais je distinguerais protection, nécessité économique et projet choisi, sans faire de l'absence de choix une explication générale des départs.

a1ae875a91dcef63c80bef0b0e8215a9d4768173.deepl_english: If disposable income no longer covers one’s needs and local opportunities are lacking, working elsewhere may seem the only viable solution. This does not negate any personal decision, but the choice is between very unequal options.
a1ae875a91dcef63c80bef0b0e8215a9d4768173.english: If the available income no longer covers one’s needs and local opportunities are lacking, working elsewhere may seem the only viable solution. This does not remove all personal choice, but the choice is between very unequal options.
a1ae875a91dcef63c80bef0b0e8215a9d4768173.french: Si les revenus disponibles ne couvrent plus les besoins et que les possibilités locales manquent, travailler ailleurs peut sembler la seule issue praticable. Cela n'efface pas toute décision personnelle, mais le choix se fait entre des options très inégales.
a1ae875a91dcef63c80bef0b0e8215a9d4768173.review_note: Revenus disponibles is available income; n'efface pas toute décision denies removing all personal choice, not negating any decision.

a7545d2c97d619fa1e29751f123b11eaf8c745a8.english: Next, insecurity can make leaving necessary in order to protect your children.
a7545d2c97d619fa1e29751f123b11eaf8c745a8.french: Ensuite, l'insécurité peut rendre le départ nécessaire pour protéger ses enfants.
a7545d2c97d619fa1e29751f123b11eaf8c745a8.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

ad59b82cd5ca506eebda618bc5c763e49f532ea5.english: In this case, speaking of complete freedom of choice obscures the constraint.
ad59b82cd5ca506eebda618bc5c763e49f532ea5.french: Dans ce cas, parler d'une liberté de choix complète masque la contrainte.

b0fa25c89c48c942106b48034d635917712d7720.english: Someone in employment may choose to join their partner abroad after comparing their plans. They accept the difficulties and give up certain habits, but this does not mean they were forced to leave their country.
b0fa25c89c48c942106b48034d635917712d7720.french: Une personne ayant un emploi peut choisir de rejoindre son partenaire à l'étranger après avoir comparé leurs projets. Elle accepte des difficultés et renonce à certaines habitudes, mais cela ne permet pas de dire qu'elle était forcée de quitter son pays.

c5ee3381801f3f5723aebf32bde0e0b698094923.english: A father has been looking unsuccessfully for work for several months. His savings are almost gone. He accepts a job abroad to cover his family's expenses, even though he would have preferred to stay close to them.
c5ee3381801f3f5723aebf32bde0e0b698094923.french: Un père cherche du travail depuis plusieurs mois, sans succès. Ses économies sont presque épuisées. Il accepte un emploi à l'étranger pour payer les dépenses de sa famille, même s'il aurait préféré rester près d'elle.
c5ee3381801f3f5723aebf32bde0e0b698094923.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

c996fcc6b389cf41b77061ad97f6707c75fbef7c.english: However, a person may present a decision taken under pressure as a positive choice, or subsequently discover new possibilities. The categories are not fixed. Without suitable data, I would not say what proportion leaves with no other choice, nor that those who remain necessarily have better options.
c996fcc6b389cf41b77061ad97f6707c75fbef7c.french: Cependant, une personne peut présenter comme un projet positif une décision prise sous pression, ou découvrir ensuite des possibilités nouvelles. Les catégories ne sont pas figées. Sans données adaptées, je ne dirais pas quelle proportion part sans autre choix, ni que ceux qui restent disposent forcément de meilleures options.

ddc78f462bd2cc4ff1d2e2a1e6ea76f14f0b5226.english: Furthermore, economic difficulties can severely limit the options available.
ddc78f462bd2cc4ff1d2e2a1e6ea76f14f0b5226.french: Ensuite, les difficultés économiques peuvent réduire fortement les options.

e173a7cfa419df068cd1c689fc693ded6296df62.english: Some departures are driven by very strong constraints. But I would be cautious about using the phrase ‘no other choice’: fleeing danger, seeking to earn a living through one’s work, and pursuing a personal project are different situations. I would not attribute a single cause to all instances of migration.
e173a7cfa419df068cd1c689fc693ded6296df62.french: Certains départs répondent à des contraintes très fortes. Mais je serais prudent avec « pas d'autre choix » : fuir un danger, chercher à vivre de son travail et réaliser un projet personnel sont des situations différentes. Je n'attribuerais pas une seule cause à toutes les migrations.

e2a9f97c92f691f6a073bad710fb73caf01dc8e9.deepl_english: Someone who cannot find work despite their best efforts may accept an offer abroad to support their household. They may prefer to stay close to their loved ones whilst still considering this offer to be, for the time being, their best option.
e2a9f97c92f691f6a073bad710fb73caf01dc8e9.english: After an unsuccessful job search, someone may accept a job abroad to support their household. They may prefer to stay close to their loved ones but still see this job abroad as their best option for now.
e2a9f97c92f691f6a073bad710fb73caf01dc8e9.french: Une personne qui ne trouve pas de travail malgré des démarches peut accepter une offre à l'étranger pour soutenir son foyer. Elle peut préférer rester près de ses proches tout en jugeant que cette offre est, pour le moment, sa meilleure possibilité.
e2a9f97c92f691f6a073bad710fb73caf01dc8e9.review_note: Conversational English keeps the family preference and the person's assessment of the offer; the original provider translation is retained.

e8901ab5f3973cced3f2a0aaa3ccc09b140a3caa.english: When you already have a job and a stable life in your country, you may choose to leave to discover something different. A better opportunity elsewhere does not necessarily mean you have to leave your country.
e8901ab5f3973cced3f2a0aaa3ccc09b140a3caa.french: Quand on a déjà un emploi et une vie stable dans son pays, on peut choisir de partir pour découvrir autre chose. Une meilleure occasion ailleurs ne signifie pas forcément qu'on est obligé de quitter son pays.
e8901ab5f3973cced3f2a0aaa3ccc09b140a3caa.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

eab5cb7c7496238d48a0ed55638e66fddb89fa92.english: Yes, I think people often leave their country because they no longer see how they can live a decent life there. Leaving then becomes a necessity rather than simply a wish. But some people also have a real option to stay.
eab5cb7c7496238d48a0ed55638e66fddb89fa92.french: Oui, je pense qu'on quitte souvent son pays parce qu'on ne voit plus comment y vivre correctement. Partir devient alors une nécessité plutôt qu'une simple envie. Mais certaines personnes ont aussi une vraie possibilité de rester.
eab5cb7c7496238d48a0ed55638e66fddb89fa92.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

eed98cb5481bd5be39ca6cf2ae75e9c7d682d786.english: When violence prevents a normal life and the authorities cannot protect the population, staying no longer offers an acceptable future. Parents then look for somewhere their children can grow up safely.
eed98cb5481bd5be39ca6cf2ae75e9c7d682d786.french: Quand la violence empêche de vivre normalement et que les autorités ne parviennent pas à protéger la population, rester n'offre plus un avenir acceptable. Les parents cherchent alors un endroit où leurs enfants pourront grandir en sécurité.
eed98cb5481bd5be39ca6cf2ae75e9c7d682d786.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

f9bf94bfed1ce4d1792f55eeadc2a22f3be97221.english: Their priority is therefore to protect their children, not to change their lifestyle.
f9bf94bfed1ce4d1792f55eeadc2a22f3be97221.french: Leur priorité est donc de protéger leurs enfants, pas de changer de mode de vie.
f9bf94bfed1ce4d1792f55eeadc2a22f3be97221.review_note: Editorial rewrite compared with the preserved Notion response; independently reviewed against the complete French intervention.

0571d42b878ff4c6285caaf0bd2e17240ac4f48d.english: In a new job, a manager can explain the instructions and check that they have been understood, rather than leaving the employee to work out the team’s practices for themselves. The employee can then ask questions and gradually take on their responsibilities.
0571d42b878ff4c6285caaf0bd2e17240ac4f48d.french: Dans un nouveau travail, un responsable peut expliquer les consignes et vérifier qu'elles sont comprises, plutôt que laisser le salarié deviner les usages de l'équipe. Celui-ci peut alors poser ses questions et exercer progressivement ses responsabilités.

06a145a15ea2f114e820a15a84a73128e07561ee.english: Making an effort is not enough if no one explains how to get involved. Clear information and people who are willing to help are what enable progress.
06a145a15ea2f114e820a15a84a73128e07561ee.french: Faire des efforts ne suffit pas si personne ne vous explique comment participer. Des informations claires et des personnes prêtes à répondre permettent d'avancer.

1af81df00f7009721a7268577836b57cfb914e76.english: But material circumstances can make these efforts easier or block them.
1af81df00f7009721a7268577836b57cfb914e76.french: Mais les conditions matérielles peuvent faciliter ou bloquer ces efforts.
1af81df00f7009721a7268577836b57cfb914e76.review_note: Human-authored English for the Education editorial pass; aligned and reviewed against the complete current French spoken intervention. No DeepL original or provider call was made for this row.

1b1283bef02cc2acabb2a62122900ddaeaa9f421.english: Someone who doesn’t know how to make an appointment over the phone can practise a few phrases with a support person, then try a simple conversation. Next time, they’ll already know how to ask for a time to be repeated, even if they don’t yet understand everything.
1b1283bef02cc2acabb2a62122900ddaeaa9f421.french: Une personne qui ne sait pas prendre rendez-vous par téléphone peut préparer quelques phrases avec un accompagnateur, puis essayer un échange simple. La fois suivante, elle sait déjà comment demander de répéter un horaire, même si elle ne comprend pas encore tout.

1e8572e23adbb70b644dabab51b1c8d830560f0b.english: The first things you need to arrange can feel daunting because you don't know how they work. With a little help and several attempts, they become more familiar. So someone's initial hesitation is not a basis for judging their abilities.
1e8572e23adbb70b644dabab51b1c8d830560f0b.french: Les premières démarches peuvent faire peur parce qu'on ne sait pas comment elles se passent. Avec un peu d'aide et plusieurs essais, elles deviennent plus familières. L'hésitation du début ne permet donc pas de juger les capacités d'une personne.
1e8572e23adbb70b644dabab51b1c8d830560f0b.review_note: Human-authored English for the Education editorial pass; aligned and reviewed against the complete current French spoken intervention. No DeepL original or provider call was made for this row.

238889044708948b847d97ff94e6e07e9e70e221.english: He can then take part more easily, instead of keeping to himself for fear of getting things wrong.
238889044708948b847d97ff94e6e07e9e70e221.french: Il peut alors participer plus facilement, au lieu de rester à l'écart par peur de mal faire.
238889044708948b847d97ff94e6e07e9e70e221.review_note: Human-authored English for the Education editorial pass; aligned and reviewed against the complete current French spoken intervention. No DeepL original or provider call was made for this row.

252a7c8c8110e929968c222a88ab7f5464474731.english: Learning the language and understanding the procedures takes time. Someone who is struggling every day to find somewhere to sleep will find it difficult to concentrate on a course, even if they want to make progress.

2560e676c8e1a2f208c8ac1671273d5a6dba55a2.english: So I believe we can develop our ability to adapt. But we need to allow time for it and take account of both the resources available and the welcome we receive.

3d567ae4a3ce1b51c4bd7c237781eb43d5bc1a8c.english: Even when you make an effort to meet people, it is hard to form relationships if everyone else keeps to their own group. An invitation to chat or share a meal gives you a chance to get to know them.
3d567ae4a3ce1b51c4bd7c237781eb43d5bc1a8c.french: Même quand on fait des efforts pour rencontrer du monde, il est difficile de créer des liens si les autres restent entre eux. Une invitation à discuter ou à partager un repas donne une occasion de faire connaissance.

48e82c0a82530a60a1bf6a9dea0aee9c8a6b365a.english: A newcomer who has to move house frequently may find it difficult to attend a regular course. Finding more stable accommodation may enable them to resume their training, without their motivation or abilities having suddenly changed.

4cddcd2b0b3bb22f9972c7759cdcde24cb223c80.english: A newcomer speaks little French and is nervous about calling the doctor's office. A neighbour helps her prepare what to say and stays with her during the call. A few weeks later, she books another appointment by phone without help.

52cacea3f5d31ad1a556e82dfb736c3f55d076d0.english: That said, personalities and needs differ. Some people prefer to return home or change their plans, even with support. This choice does not prove that they are incapable: the life on offer may simply not suit them.

5d610d4d17a01226e9d6da990f82aa9371aab901.english: Not knowing a language or how things work locally upon arrival does not mean one is incapable of learning them. A specific need makes it possible to choose a first step and to see progress.
5d610d4d17a01226e9d6da990f82aa9371aab901.french: Ne pas connaître une langue ou un fonctionnement local à l'arrivée ne signifie pas être incapable de les apprendre. Un besoin précis permet de choisir une première étape et de constater un progrès.

601f0b7ea495d83d9d10b148a42c3b95f2042ed9.english: Adaptation therefore also depends on the people who welcome us, not just on our own determination.

612e697eeb94233c69684a02e2eb1c590ec48c72.english: In conclusion, we can learn to adapt, but no one can promise that this will always succeed. 612e697eeb94233c69684a02e2eb1c590ec48c72.french: En conclusion, on peut apprendre à s'adapter, mais personne ne peut promettre que cela réussira toujours. Il faut tenir compte des efforts possibles, des moyens et de l'accueil, sans juger les personnes sur leurs premières difficultés.

62e51dd8191a406aaf6c6b8232b48e47945c7d09.english: The welcome people receive locally also makes a big difference.

93599263dc327c035fec4710a2d27ea74207aa63.english: Finally, those already there can help a newcomer to get involved.

9c37b962ca7d26088af7b6978e3daf38b7e983ee.english: Furthermore, practical circumstances can either facilitate or hinder these efforts.

a12068b0a21898a88538f7ff7c8a949ab74e2d80.english: I believe that many people can learn to adapt to life abroad, but this is not a guaranteed outcome for everyone. Progress can be made, but resources and local support are also needed. Willpower alone is not enough in every situation.

a2e063f32bc7b3d32d5ffaf9933b2cad243994db.english: I think many people can learn to adapt to life in a foreign country, but success is not guaranteed for everyone. This ability is not fixed: it develops, and the conditions you arrive in matter a great deal.
